question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would you vote for President?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Now are there any more questions, or can we go now?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: One last one, I know you think Taylor's perfect, but what is one thing you would change about her if you could?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I, um, I don't know. Maybe her bossiness?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She's bossy?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, yeah? And she's super selfish too.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know what she did to me? She made me dye my hair because my shade was way too close to hers. Isn't that tacky?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm more a brown blonde than a strawberry blonde. Red does nothing for me.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And I'm sure our female constituents would love to hear that. What else?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And then there was this time that she implied Jill was... Jill was...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Putting away too many carbs.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She always like to point out our flaws. She's, like, the worst leader ever!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She told us that if we didn't cheer for her for President, we'd get kicked off the team!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is great! Thanks for your help, girls!
As Justin walks away...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know, Jessica, maybe we shouldn't have been talking about Taylor like that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He was holding that camera...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I just hope we didn't represent Taylor badly.
At lunch the next day, Justin plays the edited video for the whole cafeteria to see!
The video shows clips of Maria and Jessica talking about Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She bosses us around, like, all the time!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She's really good at yelling at us. Sometimes she can even be a little mean.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor said that she just wasn't cut out to be a leader of anyone.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She's, like, the worst leader ever!
Justin shuts the video off.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Wow, Taylor seems really mean. I don't think she'd be a good president at all...
Taylor storms up to her cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is the meaning of this, `Maria?` `Jessica?` Is this a video that shows my bad side?! I came up with that idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: What is the meaning of this, [color=#3b78e2][i]Maria?[/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica?[/i][/color] Is this a video that shows my bad side?! I came up with that idea!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm so mad right now! I'd give up the Presidency to whip the cheerleading team in shape! No one does this to me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You don't want to be President anymore?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't care! I don't care what people want! I care what I want!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm glad everyone heard that!
$ZOE comes up to the girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: An interview.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: An interview with Justin? I don't think Taylor wants you to talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Justin, I think it's time for you to leave.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks, Maria and Jessica.
Justin walks away, dejected.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Interviewing them didn't help at all... But maybe if I edit some of this footage, I can still use it against Taylor...
At lunch the next day, Justin plays the edited video for the whole cafeteria to see!
The video shows clips of Maria and Jessica talking about Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor has...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Flaws... A single zit!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No weaknesses at all!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor makes mistakes.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...That I remember.
Justin shuts the video off.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You see?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He's lying! We didn't say any of those things!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I would never say anything about the zits that Taylor doesn't get!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He probably edited the film to make it seem like you were saying bad things.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's uncool!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unlike Taylor! Taylor's the best! Justin's the worst!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor's cool!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And if Taylor's cool... She'll make the coolest President!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aw, thank you, cheerleaders! That's so nice of you!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Vote for Taylor! Vote for Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't want a loser in office? Then vote for Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She has more supporters than ever!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Her most embarrassing moment? There was this one time that Taylor broke down at a competition.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She cried in front of us!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was a really long time ago, but one of the judges at the competition dinged us a couple points for a technicality.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor was angry about it, so she went up to the judges and told them she'd put a couple of dings in their faces.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: They disqualified her from that competition.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She cried! Taylor said that she just wasn't cut out to be a leader of anyone.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Perfect.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't think Taylor makes mistakes.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: None that I remember anyway.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! There was this one time where she chose to wear a bright pink lipstick with coral undertones during a cheer competition.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was the worst decision of her life.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, we won that year, and we couldn't even take the team photo because it was so horrendous.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I meant, a mistake that she regrets.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Trust me, she regrets that one.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Her greatest strengths? Well, it's certainly not her high kicks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh I know!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She bosses us around, like, all the time!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And she's really good at yelling at us. Sometimes she can even be a little mean.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Those are her strengths?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor can say the nicest things in the meanest ways possible!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This footage is perfect! I couldn't have planned it better myself.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Tell me about Taylor's...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor has none. No flaws. Not even a single zit. She's basically perfect.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Really, you think that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! No weaknesses at all. It's what she always tells us.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So... No weaknesses. Not one?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... Sometimes she forgets that she's so good. Is that a weakness?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is ridiculous! I can't use this footage for an anti-Taylor commercial!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let's try something different.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Tell me about Taylor's...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm a reporter for the school paper. I'm doing a story on each of the candidates in the Presidential election.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I was wondering if I could ask you girls a few questions about Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, that's what the camera's for!  Taylor will love this.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Don't you want to talk to her directly?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no. I want to ask the voters what they find interesting about Taylor. This story is really about you guys!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh good!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor doesn't really want us to talk to anyone...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I assure you, this could be a good opportunity for you to showcase Taylor at her best.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: First question. What are Taylor's greatest...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm Justin. Like Taylor, I'm a Presidential candidate. I was wondering if I could ask you girls a few questions.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What for?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How do we know you're not just trying to get dirt on Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're her enemy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not her enemy. Think of me as more of a.... Rival. I make Taylor's platform look good.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, I just want to ask a few questions. You don't even have to answer them if you don't like them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: First question. What are Taylor's greatest...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that's why you need to vote for me for President!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All the popular girls are doing it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vote for Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Vote for Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Vote for your best friend!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She means `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: She means [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I have flyers for everyone, so come and grab one. Oh, and if anyone wants my autograph, you can form a line right here. It's only $5!
$Scott and Justin weave around Taylor's fans and meet in the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She made me look like an idiot!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Of course she did. Taylor plays dirty. I don't know if you remember the last election...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And in conclusion, $Scott totally likes to eat garbage.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Everyone called me 'trashy' for three weeks! I lost a third of the votes because of that stupid rumor.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And you still won the Presidency?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This isn't a feel-good story, Justin. Taylor is going to keep spreading rumors and bad-mouthing you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You have to stop it before you lose what little support we have.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know, I know. But how do you suggest I take her down?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Make a counter-commercial! Something that will show the school that Taylor is the one everyone should be afraid of.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You can interview the cheerleaders! If you can get them to say bad things about Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A smear campaign? I like it. Come on, I have a camera in my locker. I like to keep it around for this kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: First, that's weird. Second, I can't be seen with you, remember?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But how am I going to talk to the cheerleaders without you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You'll be fine. Cheerleaders are easy to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ask about their day, compliment their hair, flirt a little. You know, small talk.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do I look like the kind of person that does 'small talk?'

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay. At least try not to talk down to them. It'll be good practice for you, Future President.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And while I'm doing that, what are `you` going to be doing for the cause, Future Vice President?
nodes.text_bbcode: And while I'm doing that, what are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] going to be doing for the cause, Future Vice President?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `Hiding!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hiding![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $Scott dashes away just as Angie enters the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Where is he? I thought for sure he'd be here...
Angie leaves.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now to work...
That afternoon, video camera in hand, Justin walks to the football field where the cheerleaders are painting signs for a rally.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Perfect. Taylor's not here! I just need clips of different cheerleaders saying things about Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But how am I going to do that?
Justin walks up to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What are you doing here? Are you lost?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know that chess club meets in the library, right?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not in chess club. Don't you recognize me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait. These are popular girls. They don't remember who I am... Which means, they don't know I'm also running for President...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Listen, girls, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No one else thinks they looks like aliens that want to take over your brain?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No one thinks they're a little bit strange?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I guess I thought the same thing when my little sister was a baby...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Even if that's true, who wants Justin to be President anyway? He barely has a social life!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And, please, what's with his hair?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: She's right! His hair's stupid, so he'd make a stupid president!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We all saw you say that!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You can do anything with a computer these days. It could've been doctored.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Justin's a doctor?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I know Justin's not a doctor. Who do you think we are? Idiots?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The thought did cross my mind...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, Justin's the idiot!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So it doesn't look like you swayed any of Jane's voters over to our side...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Following the debates yesterday, Jane is still predicted to hold a third of the ballots, putting her in a tie with Taylor and Hector for President'.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'In other news, chicken nugget sales have increased...'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't even make the school paper today! I'd better step it up somehow...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now our time is almost over. Candidates, you'll have one last thing to say about yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And then we go to lunch!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Jane, what would you like to say?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Voting for me is making a statement against the institution. By voting for me, you're voting against the very system you're voting in!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Remember a vote for Jane is a vote for all!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And Justin? Any last words?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I do have a few actually.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Jane, you said that voting for you is making a statement against the system of voting.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, so?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But wouldn't the better statement be to not vote at all?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If you really want to stop us from voting, you should stop voting.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You mean protest by non-participation?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I... Didn't think of it that way. But you're completely right!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: A vote for no one is a vote for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, a vote for no one is a vote for Jane! If you want to support Jane, vote for no one!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He's right! We're buying into the system if we vote!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Vote for no one!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Vote for no one!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Thank you, Centerscore students! Come election day, I hope you all remember to Not-Vote!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But if you must, then vote for Justin!
Justin leaves the stage to the sound of applause!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just one more thing...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Jane, you said that voting for you is making a statement against the system of voting.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, so?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But with you in office, there will be no President. How will things get done?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Exactly my point. The system is broken, and if you vote for Jane, you'll fix it!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: We don't want some stuffy President in office! We want to `be` the office!
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't want some stuffy President in office! We want to [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] the office!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Vote for Jane!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Vote for Jane!
Justin leaves the stage as students clamor to see more of Jane.
The next day at lunch, Justin reads about the polls in the school paper.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: A daily poll? What kind of questions are you going to ask?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How good of a job they think I'm doing?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And you're really going to listen to that?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't hear you suggest anything better.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I was going to ask students what they wanted. A poll like that just means you're going to do whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's not exactly true!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But it's partially true!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: A suggestion box? Really? Weren't you the one that tried to laugh that idea out of office during the Valentine's Day Ball?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I `was...` Until I realized how powerful it really is!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]was...[/i][/color] Until I realized how powerful it really is!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How else are we going to let students run the school? It's all very nice to say students should make their own decisions, but...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's harder to make sure everyone has a voice in the process.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What better way to do it than asking them for their suggestions?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What were you planning to do?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I was going to ask them to their face. How is a suggestion box better than that?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Because students don't always say what they want directly. If it's anonymous, they'll be more open and honest.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hmmm.... That's not a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... What was the question?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: If you're not paying attention, Justin, I'm seriously wondering how well you're going to do as President.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Great, I guess I'm not surprised that even Shapiro's not on my side.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: All right. Next question. And again, Jane will answer first, then Justin will get the chance to respond.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: If you are President, what will you do to ensure you are meeting the students' needs?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Under my new system of government, there will be no President, so I will not be the one meeting the students' needs.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: They will be making their own decisions and creating shared visions of what they want.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: The students will be in charge of their own happiness.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Justin, what do you say?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If I were President, I'd make sure I'd address everyone's needs by putting out a...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Government shouldn't have too much power.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But there should be people in office trying to create and complete projects.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The students should vote for their policies, and government should listen.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Without that, the situation at school would be pretty `Dyre.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Without that, the situation at school would be pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]Dyre.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But we all hated Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Exactly. We don't want a strong government. But there's nothing wrong with a governing body that's looking to protect students.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hah, `Dyre.` I hated that guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hah, [color=#e23b3b][i]Dyre.[/i][/color] I hated that guy.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Government should have the power to enforce control and order.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It makes the school safer that way.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: When we had Principal Dyre, he enforced control and order through tons and tons of rules.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Who here enjoyed having Dyre around?
The audience is silence.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: The defense rests.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This isn't a court of law!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Arg, this isn't good. She still has everyone else's support!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Government should be what?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uhm... It should be there?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: A monkey would've made a more compelling argument.
The audience laughs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Arg, this isn't good. She still has everyone else's support!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: If you become President, what will be the first thing you plan to do in office?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Jane, you answer first, then Justin will respond to your answer.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: If I become President, my first priority will be to abolish the system that keeps us from exercising our rights!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: As my platform states, we don't want to adhere to or be subservient to a government!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That's why I will dismantle it and instate a communal voting system in its place.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Justin, your response?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's interesting, Jane. If there is no government, who will make sure the votes are equally represented? How will we accomplish what people want?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Presidents and governments are supposed to help raise funds and rally people together to get things done.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Personally, I think government should be...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The power to make real change around here!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh yeah, and who's going to be making those changes?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I am, of course! The power is mine!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: This is just the kind of government that needs to be squashed! No one can tell us what to do!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not telling you what to do!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm doing it for you!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Exactly! We don't need `your` help.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! We don't need [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] help.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: That's enough. Now for your first debate question...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's not what they wanted to hear at all!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: To make changes that everyone believes in!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If I become president, the government won't work for itself... It'll work for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah! That sounds good! Make them work for us!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Thank you, Justin. Now for your first debate question...
Justin freezes!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that's the Presidential candidate Justin. A man of few words.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And fewer actions...
The audience laughs!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I really ruined my chances there...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Moving on to the debate questions. Here's your first one...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Don't detract from the candidates. Go after the people voting for them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I hardly think taking down students will boost my poll numbers. Although if there are fewer students...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I didn't mean `go after them`, like get rid of them. I meant, appeal to them!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't mean [color=#e23b3b][i]go after them[/i][/color], like get rid of them. I meant, appeal to them!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's something you seem to forget about being a President, Justin. You serve other people. They only vote for you if you represent what they want.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You'll have your first chance tomorrow. You're debating against Jane.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All of her supporters are going to be in the audience. Figure out a way to get their attention.
Suddenly, from the edge of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott! Are you out here, $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...That's our cue to run! We'll talk more about this later! You can do it!
$Scott and Justin part ways quickly.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Get their attention? Easier said than done.
The next day, at the debates, Justin and Principal Shapiro wait at the stage for Jane to arrive.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: There she is!
Jane walks into the auditorium trailed by a group of her supporters.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Jane, you definitely have our votes.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah. Who else is going to stop the school from letting us use our education however we want?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You guys, I'm running for President because I don't support the Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: That's deep.
Jane takes the stage.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Candidates, we'll begin. Each candidate will have about a minute to make a few opening remarks about their platform and their position.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Then there will be a short, two-question debate between the opponents.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Only two debate questions? But I prepared an entire stack of proposals and possible answers...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: We only have the lunch period, Justin. You'll have to make your points quickly and briefly.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now Jane, you won the coin toss, so you get the first chance to talk about your platform as well as answer the debate questions.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You have one minute to make your opening remark. What platform are you running under?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'm Jane for the Protest Party, and we protest against student government! I want to be President, so that I can turn the power over to the people!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Go, Jane!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Students don't need to be governed by any one person, but by everyone making communal decisions for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We like power in our hands!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And that's why I say, 'Everyone Wins when Jane Wins'!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Thank you. Now your turn, Justin. What is your platform?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They don't want a government! How can I possibly go against `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They don't want a government! How can I possibly go against [color=#e23b3b][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, don't give up, Justin. $Scott said to appeal to Jane's voters. If I say things they like, I'll be fine!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thank you, Principal Shapiro. Fellow students, I am Justin of the Presidential Party. I want to become President for the...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is just the sort of thing I've come to expect from you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean? That I never have good ideas?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's not like `you're` doing so well. If I weren't on the ballot, I'm not even sure we'd be second.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not like [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] doing so well. If I weren't on the ballot, I'm not even sure we'd be second.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't you think I've tried?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I can't start a smear campaign against popular people. I'd get slaughtered. They have more power than I do!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If I tried to say something bad about Taylor or Hector for instance, who do you think people would side with?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, not with you. Of course if you try to insult the popular kids, it'll backfire in your face.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But... It depends on how you do it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's even something that `I` already thought of.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's even something that [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] already thought of.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Gee, thanks, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's kind of a compliment, coming from you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, 'thought of'? You've already tried this?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not exactly. Look, I can't start a smear campaign against popular people. I'd get slaughtered. They have more clout and power than I do!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If I tried to say something bad about Taylor or Hector for instance, who do you think people would side with?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not with you. But it depends on how you do it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The polls show we're not doing very well.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. I don't know what else to do though.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I feel good about what we're selling in our campaign. You have good ideas! Wheelchair ramps for the disabled... A healthier snack program...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And getting to eat lunch off campus? Sweet! We could go to Cheese-Teasers every day!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Kinda defeats the purpose of the healthy snack program... But it is pretty awesome.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But it's not enough, Justin. I've seen the polls. If we're going to win, you're going to have to step it up.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have been! I've been making better, fancier, longer speeches...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Those confuse people...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've been putting up posters...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Which Taylor posters `over...`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Which Taylor posters [color=#e23b3b][i]over...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And I've been blogging, haven't I?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Justin, come on. Who really visits justin-knows-everything.com?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: First of all, it's listen-to-justin.com, and second... It's not like you've been very supportive.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know. But I'm here now. And listen, if we're going to win, you're going to have to go on the offensive! Go after the other candidates!

options.label: That's surprisingly not a terrible idea.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I'll do whatever it takes to help me win...
After stopping by Lost and Found, Justin finds $Scott standing in the center of the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh good! You wore the trench coat!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Advising you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Is this a game to you? Why did you call me out here?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's not a game! And I called you out here because... Well, Angie isn't thrilled that I'm running with you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What about the trench coat?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You mean these awesome spy coats?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay. Let's back up. Angie's not happy we're running together?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Is this about the whole 'me blackmailing her to break up with you' thing? Because I apologized for that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah well... That didn't help. So I shouldn't be seen with you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks for wearing the trench coat. They're cool `and` keep anyone from identifying us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for wearing the trench coat. They're cool [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] keep anyone from identifying us!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So, why are we out here in the parking lot?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm happy you asked.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Forget that! I won't be made a fool!
Justin walks into the parking lot...
When suddenly, someone tackles him behind a dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Gah! I'm being mugged!
Justin falls into a pile of garbage!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ewww, gross! There are banana peels in here! Hey, what gives?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You didn't wear a trench coat!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott, you're the one that wanted to meet me out here?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Shh! She might hear you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Who? Angie?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes! She's not happy I'm running with you...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... The blackmail thing?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I apologized, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Still. We can't be seen together.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And you thought a coat was going to fix that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know that I haven't been the most supportive vice president...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You run when you see me! Maybe Angie's not happy that we're on the same ballot, but I still need your support.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Which is why we're here!
The elections for student body President are just around the corner, and Justin is looking at the Presidential polls in the school paper!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Three days until the ballots open for the President...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And I'm trailing behind everyone else!
Justin scans the school paper and finds an article with predictions on the poll results.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'In first place, an unprecedented three-way tie for the following candidates...'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Taylor for the Popular Party, Jane for the Protest Party, and Hector for the Party Party...'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'And in a distant second... The Presidential Party duo, Justin and $Scott...'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Looks like I'm going to lose by a landslide! I don't get it. I'm doing everything I can!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm campaigning for all the things we need... Better security measures, more resources for test prep, funding for academic tutoring...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I guess $Scott's not helping any! Even though he's my vice president, I haven't seen him around long enough to plan anything.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not that I'd want to plan strategy with him, but...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How am I going to get all the votes I need in time? Guess I should go put up more posters.
Justin stands up when his cell phone rings! He looks at his phone.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Unknown caller?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Justin... I know why you're not leading in the polls...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Yes. Meet me in the parking lot in ten minutes, and I'll tell you how you can win.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: And wear a trench coat.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Where am I going to get a trench coat?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Check the Lost and Found. Someone turned one in for you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait a minute, who is this, and why should I listen to you?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: My name is not important. What's important is the information I have for you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Parking lot in ten minutes?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Don't forget the trench coat.
The phone goes dead.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have no idea who this person is. It could be some sort of trick... And I'll be identifiable wearing a trench coat in this warm weather...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It could be anyone!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I think this will work!
Justin returns home and sets up his party.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hosting's harder than I thought!
Justin turns to find Hector and Amanda approaching him.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hector, you came to my party?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't pass up the opportunity to party. I'm the party king after all!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but this party is kind of cool!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: High praise from the Party Party-er himself!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now I know that if I lose, at least, we'll still have someone who can fight the good fight!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or should I say, party the good party?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know, man. I remember my first party. It was hard to keep up with everyone.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I couldn't get the music on, and I kept forgetting to make sure my guests had fun...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This party's good, but I'm sure you'll hit your stride... Someday.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I couldn't impress Hector. This isn't going to look good for the election tomorrow...
Meanwhile, as Justin hosts his party...
Taylor plans a surprise of her own.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Justin's trying to throw the best campaign party ever? I know just what this party needs...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A little unexpected chaos!
Taylor flips a switch on the breaker!
Inside, all the lights and music shut off, blanketing everyone in total darkness!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, Justin, what just happened?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This definitely wasn't part of the plan!
Justin looks around and sees Erik!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, can you do me a favor? Maria and Jacob want to play a game, but I'm just fresh out of them!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'd be happy to!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, guys, wait up! Don't go that way! Come play a game instead!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: A game?
Erik follows Jacob and Maria.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know what's fun to do with three people? Pin the tail on the donkey!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oooh boy! I get so dizzy! No one knows `where` I'm going to put that donkey tail!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oooh boy! I get so dizzy! No one knows [color=#e23b3b][i]where[/i][/color] I'm going to put that donkey tail!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ha ha. You know what, this kid's kind of cute.
They come back downstairs.
Maria and Jacob go upstairs, while Justin continues to watch over the party.
A minute later, there's a loud crash!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no...
Justin runs upstairs to the kitchen...
And walks in on Jacob and Maria standing over a broken lamp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh, Justin! Sorry, I don't know what happened.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You might want to try not walking around in the dark.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Need help cleaning?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No... You've done enough.
Back at the party...
From the corner of his eye, Justin sees Maria and Jacob, laughing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Come on, this way!
Maria takes Jacob by the hand and starts heading upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: My parents will kill me if they found out I let someone make out anywhere in the house!
Justin walks over to the two thugs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Want me to change the music for you?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No need. That's what we're trying to do.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: So we're not trying to take the stereo?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, you imbecile. We're trying to upload my music so we can duke it out on the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Now I got it figured out.
Ryan pushes a button on the stereo. Hip-hop dance music blasts from the speakers!
All the rebels flock to the middle of the room to dance!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Now this is what I'm talking about!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: `Yeah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yeah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Nice music, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not mine, but I'll take it!
Justin confronts Ryan and Travis.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What does it look like?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It looks like you're trying to take my stereo. Did you think I would be too busy to notice?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No! Your music's junk. I was going to change it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But I can tell when we're not wanted. Come on, $Travis. Let's get out of here.
Ryan and $Travis leave the party.
Justin turns back to the party to find the bullies fiddling with the stereo equipment!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Should I stop them?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Nothing. I'm just trying to make sure everyone's having a good time...
CRASH!
The fish tank has shattered on the floor! Fish flop about everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Save the fish!
Justin cleans up the fish tank and puts the fish in glasses of water.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just try `not` to touch anything else, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: Just try [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] to touch anything else, okay?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sure thing!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry, I'll be right back!
Justin runs to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Just hold it still for one more second... I'll take the water sample from here...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Dex, I don't think I have a good grip on this thing...
Erik nearly drops the tank! Justin runs in and steadies him.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks. Close call. Almost didn't get that sample.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Please don't lift the fish tank again.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure thing!
At the snack bar, Justin runs into Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, you're the guy running for President? The one running with $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm in the physics club. I heard about you and that you're majorly into robots.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They're a side project of mine. When I'm not campaigning for office. But...
Justin spies Erik and Dex lifting his parents' gigantic fish tank!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is something wrong?
Justin dives for the drink!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, excuse me, can you not put your drink on that table?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She can't put her drink down?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not without one of these.
Justin slides a coaster over.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Seriously. Water rings from cups can warp wood. The damage is irreversible!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, it's okay. I'm just going to go set my drink down over there. We can sit over there, right?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's still a wooden table.
Justin walks away.
Justin walks over with a bowl of chips and a coaster.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Some more chips?
$ZOE takes a chip from the bowl Justin sets down. He puts a coaster under her drink.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! That's really sweet of you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No problem.
Justin walks away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a really nice place for a party, don't you think, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like Justin put in a lot of hard work into it. It's good. Nice atmosphere.
Howard puts an arm around $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Especially with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...
A handful of people arrive, barely filling up Justin's family room.
From the sidelines, Justin watches over the party.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Without $Scott, barely a quarter of the school showed up.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Come in! Glad you could make it!
Justin steps aside to let the cheerleaders into the house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope you don't mind... I brought some cookies over.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They aren't peanut butter cookies, are they? Because peanut allergies are becoming more rampant and...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, I mean... Just kidding! These cookies look delicious!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You can put them down on the table. Help yourself to drinks and snacks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
Nicole leans over to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, this guy's kind of nice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, is this where the party is being held?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you want us to come in?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You might want to move, so we can go in...
Justin scrambles aside as $ZOE and the cheerleaders file into the house.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: This guy's kind of weird...
A couple hours later, $Scott arrives at Justin's house in a trench coat!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I hope this will work...
Justin returns home and sets up his party.
After school the next day, Justin runs into $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Psst! Justin! Whatever you said to Angie, it didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So it's all up to you. Send out as many invites as you can.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And after that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: After that, all you have to do is take care of the three party essentials: delicious snacks, awesome music, and sparkly decorations.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have to get all of those things?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If you want to throw the best party ever, keep track of the small details.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait, does this mean you're not coming to the party?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll sneak in from time to time! But I can't help you set up.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Don't worry! You'll be fine! Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How hard can this be?
At the party store that afternoon, Justin searches through the aisles for decorations.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott said the key to an awesome party is decorations, snacks, and killer music.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I have no idea where to start... The last time I threw a party, the highlight was watching the gold fish in my tank swim laps.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now is not the time to panic. If $Scott can throw a party, so can you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Delicious snacks, awesome music, sparkly decorations...

nodes.prompt: Choose the right things for a party!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Really? My boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, think about what he wants. He wants to be in office again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure `you` just want to be in office again.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] just want to be in office again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott will be perfectly happy either way.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So, you're not going to let him do it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He can do whatever he likes, but I'm not going to give him permission.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Are we done here?
Justin leaves the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott's not going to jump in.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Really? You're going to argue for the school?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Of course. You may not like me, but you like Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And $Scott and I are the only ones who want to make real changes here. Changes that will really help.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And why should I trust you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've become a better person...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No. Not really. But I'm telling you that without $Scott, we'll lose.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe you disagree with how I get things done, but I do care about being a good President.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I'm not thrilled about you and $Scott running together.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I'm not going to stand in his way either, so do whatever it is you two need to do.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You have my blessing. Just don't talk to me again.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What if you just go talk to her? I'll help if she says she's cool with it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sure... If that's what it takes.
Justin finds Angie hard at work during study hall. He sits next to her.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Angie, care to talk?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It'll get me out of your way faster.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Fine. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott is my Vice President. And lately he hasn't been working with me because he wants to make you happy.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Of course he does. He is my boyfriend, no thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And what do you want from me? It's not like `I'm` making him stay away from you.
nodes.text_bbcode: And what do you want from me? It's not like [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] making him stay away from you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sure you are. He knows you don't like that he's running with me, so he's trying to stay out of it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What do you want from me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Your go-ahead. You tell $Scott that you're okay if he works with me.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I'm not okay with it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I need to get her on my side.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Angie, do this for...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's decent of you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But if she didn't forgive you the first time, I don't think a second one's going to work.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What else should I do?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If I'm President, we can give her position as Secretary again.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe even promise her some funding for the chemistry lab she's so fond of.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You can't bribe Angie!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't even believe you'd say that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What else should I do?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was going to tell you that we're doing pretty badly... It looks like we're still dead last.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Taylor's successful campaign put her first above competitors Jane and Hector.'

nodes.text: 'In other news, the rise in fake hall pass usage has prompted local authorities to increase security...'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't even make the school paper today!

nodes.text: One more day until election. Let's see where I stand.

nodes.text: Glad to hear it.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Welcome to the annual school elections. I have with me the ballots that will determine your next student body president.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: We'll work our way from the bottom. With exactly one vote is a write-in candidate by the name of Dexter!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay! That's my vote, Dex!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I have some tallies here for 'Pony'...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pony for President!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Next up, I have a lot of 'I am not voting for Jane' ballots that were filled out.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Wooo! Thanks, everyone, for your generous un-support!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Be that as it may... We cannot count 'non-votes' for the Presidential election.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And with a total of thirty-three votes, I have Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did I win?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Sorry, dear, but no. You did place in third, though.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, whatever. Even without the Presidency, I still win as head cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And with forty-eight votes, I have Hector from the Party Party.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And finally, in the lead with a landslide by sixty votes...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Your new student body president is Justin!
Justin and $Scott high-five!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It worked?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah! You did it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I may have had a little help...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are you trying to thank me, Justin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wouldn't dream of it. I did all the leg-work after all.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah right! You wouldn't even have known where to start without me.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, I did some of the work too. Give me a break.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not a chance!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ha ha!
Justin won! We knew you could help him beat the odds and take the office!
It looks like $Scott and Justin are going to do everything they wanted this year thanks to you!
You played a great game!

nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oooooh! We teleported into space!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Though the doctor said that if I start seeing stars, I should go to the hospital right away...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Justin, did you plan this?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, it's just my star collection. I put them up a long time ago. I guess I forgot about them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait, you guys, it's dark in here! Shouldn't we party someplace else?

nodes.text: Are you kidding me? The stars in here are way closer than they are outside!

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Finished reading the polls? Unsure what to do next? Don't place last when you can place 7th! Dial 33-56-27 for answers!'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Finish 7th? There are only four candidates. And that last part's not a phone number...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's a locker combination!

nodes.text: Aw man... $Scott, come on! I'm not wearing that!

nodes.text: Then you're jeopardizing the mission!

nodes.text: Grab the trench coat. Walk with me. It's not safe here.

nodes.text: Forget it. Just say what you need to say.

nodes.text: The only opponent we haven't tried to take down is Hector. He's cool, he's popular...

nodes.text: And everyone wants to vote for him because the dude's going to throw a lot of parties.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How does this help me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The only way to take him down is to out-party the Party Party!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding. `Me?` Throw a party? I hate parties.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've got to be kidding. [color=#e23b3b][i]Me?[/i][/color] Throw a party? I hate parties.

nodes.text: That explains all the time you spent vetoing my party budgets when I was President...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You were trying to spring for a bounce house.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It looked `fun!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It looked [color=#e23b3b][i]fun![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It looked `expensive.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It looked [color=#e23b3b][i]expensive.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, okay. That doesn't matter now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What does matter is that the only way you're going to defeat Hector is if you prove to everyone you `can` throw a good party.
nodes.text_bbcode: What does matter is that the only way you're going to defeat Hector is if you prove to everyone you [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] throw a good party.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Fine. Where do we start?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh... About that. I can't be seen with you. Angie? Remember?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no... I can't do this alone. I don't know the first thing about hosting social gatherings! This is your job.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But Angie...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Forget Angie. I'm surprised you're willing to let yourself be bossed around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm not being bossed around. I'm trying to make her happy.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Try to make her any more happy, and this party is going to fail.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, $Scott, I need you to invite everyone and be there. Can't you help me out?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, maybe if you hadn't blackmailed her in the first place, I could help you a little more.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Fine. What do you say I...

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Whoops, looks like the party's over...

nodes.text: Come on, girls, let's head home.

nodes.text: Yeah, let's all go there!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Party at Hector's house!

nodes.text: Let's clear out of this place. A house party with bikinis? I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Jacob

nodes.text: Sorry. When it's over, it's over.

nodes.text: I'm sorry, man.

nodes.text: Hope you losers enjoy the rest of your party. Alone.

nodes.text: What? I can't even see girls dancing? I'm leaving.
The jocks leave.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait! I have more snacks and drinks and cool things...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're leaving me too?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I did everything I could to help you out, but our party's over. We'll see what happens at the polls tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'd like to start by inviting all our candidates up here to congratulate them on a job well done...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You made it very hard to choose, I'm sure.
All the candidates walk onstage to the students' applause.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And now for the moment we've been waiting for... Your next student body president is...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Hector from the Party Party!
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thank you, Centerscore! I couldn't have done it without you! And me! And... Without the help of my new vice president, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott?! You're supposed to be `my` Vice President!
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott?! You're supposed to be [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] Vice President!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin. I left the ticket as soon as I saw the polls. You weren't going to win. You and I both knew that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm on a new ticket now. It's a brand new era here at Centerscore! Without you, Justin.
Oh no! $Scott betrayed you, your party was a mess, and you made Amanda cry!
It's hard to call this a proper ending at all! Try again and see if you can help Justin become President!

nodes.text: $Scott?

nodes.text: I'm glad you got the hint.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Can't you just send me a text or drop me a note like a normal person?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Come to the cafeteria quick!

nodes.text: Down with the government!

nodes.text: Exactly, Jane! When there's no government, there's no structure.

nodes.text: Jane's trying to get rid of the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Booo!

nodes.speaker: Justin

nodes.text: Great. Grab the chump, and let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Alexei?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What is going on?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Looks like we got the drop on you, Centerscore losers! We have your President. We're going to kidnap him and ransom him.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ransom him for what?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Whatever we can think of! So long, suckers!
Alexei and Steph grab a tightly bound Dex and escape in the chaos of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Get them!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Who are you talking to?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry. Reflex. Back when we had C.R.E.E.P., someone would've listened to me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, not anymore...
Dex is the new President by write-in? And he was kidnapped by a task force of Wilson High agents?
This isn't how things should end! Try again and see if you can help Justin become President instead and hopefully avoid this mess!
And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't see, Hector! I can't see!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't move around, babe! I'll find you... Hang on, where are you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Eeeeek!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eeeeek![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone hears a fall and a snap!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My leg... Sniffle... Sniffle... It's broken again, I think! I won't be able to cheerlead again!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Justin, $Scott. This is `your` doing. I knew I shouldn't have come. Everything always ends up a disaster with you two.
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin, $Scott. This is [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] doing. I knew I shouldn't have come. Everything always ends up a disaster with you two.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First the Winter Formal, now this? Haven't you hurt Amanda enough?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry, man.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You wanted to be President to take care of the student body? You're not even doing a good job now, and the elections didn't even happen.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm leaving, and I'm carrying Amanda with me.
Hector leaves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could you? Breaking her leg again? And we don't even have a backup cheerleader this time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hope you losers enjoy the rest of your party. Alone.
The cheerleaders leave.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What? I can't even see girls dancing? I'm leaving.
The jocks leave.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait! I have more snacks and drinks and cool things...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're leaving me too?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I did everything I could to help you out, but our party's over. We'll see what happens at the polls tomorrow.
The next day at the elections...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'd like to start by inviting all our candidates up here to congratulate them on a job well done...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You made it very hard to choose, I'm sure.
All the candidates walk onstage to the students' applause.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And now for the moment we've been waiting for... Your next student body president is...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Hector from the Party Party!
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thank you, Centerscore! I couldn't have done it without you! And me! And... Without the help of my new vice president, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott?! You're supposed to be `my` Vice President!
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott?! You're supposed to be [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] Vice President!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin. I left the ticket as soon as I saw the polls. You weren't going to win. You and I both knew that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm on a new ticket now. It's a brand new era here at Centerscore! Without you, Justin.
Oh no! $Scott betrayed you, your party was a mess, and you made Amanda cry!
It's hard to call this a proper ending at all! Try again and see if you can help Justin become President!
And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'As of the Presidential debates yesterday, Taylor and Hector are leading in the polls'...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Justin follows in second'...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'But most surprisingly, after changing her party slogan, Jane has slipped to third in the running'.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Remember everyone wins when they don't vote for Jane.'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And when no one votes for Jane, I'm closer to winning.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Excellent. This is all going according to plan.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It looks like you got the votes from the Protest Party...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Or should I say you got all the non-votes?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: 'In election news, after showing her distaste for politics, Taylor plummets below Justin and Jane...'

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: 'While Hector retains his strong lead...'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Only one contender left. Things are unfolding exactly as I planned.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was going to tell you that we're okay. Good work. We definitely have a better shot than we did before.
At school the next day...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie gave the go-ahead. I'm going to start recruiting everyone to come.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All you have to do is take care of the three party essentials: delicious snacks, awesome music, and sparkly decorations.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have to get all that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If you want to throw the best party ever, keep track of the small details.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'll show up right before the party to check things out. Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How hard can this be?
A couple hours later, $Scott arrives at Justin's house!
One after another, students arrive until Justin's house is full of people!
From the sidelines, Justin watches over the party.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I think the entire school showed up!
At that moment, the lights come back on!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And we're back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's okay, Amanda. Now we can dance!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! This is the best party ever!
Near Justin and $Scott, Taylor shoves a bowl of chips over!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, I went through a lot of trouble to find those breakers and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Cut off the lights?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't say that...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Nice try, Taylor, but you're not going to snowball the best Vice-Presidential candidate in the election.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie? You're `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Angie? You're [color=#e23b3b][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's your campaign party. I wouldn't miss it for anything.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Besides, without me to turn the lights back on, you'd all be standing alone in the dark.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, I had it covered...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But thanks for watching my back.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I didn't do this for `you,` Justin. I did it for $Scott and the school.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't do this for [color=#3b78e2][i]you,[/i][/color] Justin. I did it for $Scott and the school.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So while this doesn't mean I'll forgive you...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm willing to support you.
In fact, it was the `perfect` one! Here's your bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, it was the [b]perfect[/b] one! Here's your bonus scene!

nodes.text: One fine Saturday at Erik's house on Maple Drive, Erik and Dex wait at home...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for coming over, Dex. I don't know if I could stand to wait all by myself.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What are we waiting for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My sister's coming here! Today!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So she's been living with my mom in Norway this entire time.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I haven't seen her since I was two. And that doesn't really count because I don't remember anything from when I was two!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Wow, so you've never met your sister?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope. It's just been me and my dad this entire time.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't even know what she looks like.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hope we have the same interests.
The doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's her!
Erik throws open the door to reveal Astrid!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Astrid! You're here! You're really here!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Enrique! My pork cutlet of brotherly love!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, my name is Erik.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Why of course it is... That is what I said!
Astrid wraps Erik in a hug, then kisses both of his cheeks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am `here!` At last, it is so wonderful to be in America!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]here![/i][/color] At last, it is so wonderful to be in America!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I cannot wait to eat their skinny hot dogs, their cheeseful pizzas, their historic malls!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, you don't really eat a `mall... `
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you don't really eat a [color=#e23b3b][i]mall... [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ooh! And I have brought souvenirs for you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gifts? For me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh happy day!
Astrid gives Erik a box. He tears it open!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cups!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Actually they're 'clogs'!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Clogs? Clogs! What a great word! Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: There is still one more surprise left in that box.
Erik reaches inside to retrieve...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A shirt that says `Space 'Splosions` on it with a Norwegian flag in the middle?!
nodes.text_bbcode: A shirt that says [color=#e23b3b][i]Space 'Splosions[/i][/color] on it with a Norwegian flag in the middle?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is the best first gift a sister has ever given me!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I have a feeling you and I will get along as well as two peas in a wool blanket!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How long are you back for?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, my little cream puff, I am staying for a long, long time...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And I shall start at that Centerscore school tomorrow!
Astrid is ready to start at Centerscore, but is Centerscore ready for Astrid?
